KeyModifier.description:
Keyboard modifier flags. Multiple flags may be combined; the
extension folds them into CDP's bitfield (`alt=1, ctrl=2, meta=4,
shift=8`).

delta_x.description: Native CDP wheel input in CSS pixels. Positive X means right. Not measured displacement.

delta_y.description: Native CDP wheel input in CSS pixels. Positive Y means down. Defaults to zero.

ref.description:
Optional `@e<N>` ref used as the wheel event's hit-test point.
Mutually exclusive with `selector`. When neither is supplied,
the event is dispatched at the viewport centre.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.
